acv.quote: A hundred and eighty K a year, on a three-year term.

header.reason: A Fetchwell engineer built a working sitter payment flow over a weekend, which turned a bake-off into a win. Priya called it clean, but PayPal, Venmo and saved-card questions stayed open.

findings.label: What started it
findings.finding: Lead with ending the engineering time spent keeping payments running.
findings.why: Fetchwell was launching Canada and the UK while two engineers spent nearly full-time keeping sitter payments working.
findings.quote: Two engineers more or less full-time just keeping sitter payments working.

findings.label: Who decided
findings.finding: Aim the main message at the head of engineering, not finance.
findings.why: Daniel, VP of Engineering, signed. The CFO joined for ten minutes and asked one question.
findings.quote: this is an engineering decision, finance will sign what I bring them.

findings.label: The competitor
findings.finding: Say plainly what happens to PayPal, Venmo and saved cards.
findings.why: After Fetchwell met Braintree, the questions turned to what they would lose. Priya only guesses Braintree caused it.
findings.quote: It went from 'how fast can we build this' to 'what do we lose.'

findings.label: Our message
findings.finding: Cut the average approval uplift claim for small-booking apps.

line.text: Authorization Boost increases acceptance rates by 3.8% on average

findings.why: The acceptance-rate slide got silence. Daniel said 38 dollar bookings made approval rates a non-issue.
findings.quote: our average booking is 38 dollars, I'm not losing sleep over auth rates.

findings.label: Missing proof
findings.finding: Add a customer story of moving saved cards at Fetchwell's size.
findings.why: Daniel asked for one and never got it. The worry came up again at kickoff.
findings.quote: who's done this at our size without losing cards?

findings.label: Their words
findings.finding: Say 'sitter pay' and 'paid by Friday' instead of 'payouts'.

line.text: Instant payouts 24x7, including weekends and holidays

findings.why: Fetchwell's promise to sitters is 'paid by Friday'. The CFO's only question was about when sitters get paid.
findings.quote: does this change when sitters get paid?
